sql: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION record_changed() RETURNS text LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $$DECLARE r record; x text; i integer; BEGIN FOR i IN 1..2 LOOP IF i=1 THEN SELECT 1::integer AS v INTO r; ELSE SELECT 'two'::text AS v INTO r; END IF;  SELECT r.v::text INTO x; END LOOP; RETURN x; END$$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION record_lazy() RETURNS text LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $$DECLARE r record; x text; i integer; BEGIN FOR i IN 1..2 LOOP IF i=1 THEN SELECT 1::integer AS v INTO r; ELSE SELECT 'two'::text AS v INTO r; END IF;  SELECT CASE WHEN i=1 THEN r.v::text ELSE 'skip' END INTO x; END LOOP; RETURN x; END$$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION record_missing_lazy() RETURNS text LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $$DECLARE r record; x text; i integer; BEGIN FOR i IN 1..2 LOOP IF i=1 THEN SELECT 1::integer AS v INTO r; ELSE SELECT 'two'::text AS other INTO r; END IF;  SELECT CASE WHEN i=1 THEN r.v::text ELSE 'skip' END INTO x; END LOOP; RETURN x; END$$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION record_discarded() RETURNS text LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $$DECLARE r record; x text; i integer; BEGIN FOR i IN 1..2 LOOP IF i=1 THEN SELECT 1::integer AS v INTO r; ELSE SELECT 'two'::text AS v INTO r; END IF; EXECUTE 'DISCARD PLANS'; SELECT r.v::text INTO x; END LOOP; RETURN x; END$$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION record_typmod() RETURNS text LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $$DECLARE r record; x text; i integer; BEGIN FOR i IN 1..2 LOOP IF i=1 THEN SELECT 'one'::varchar(3) AS v INTO r; ELSE SELECT 'two'::varchar(10) AS v INTO r; END IF; SELECT r.v::text INTO x; END LOOP; RETURN x; END$$
